exposure: Implementation of the Ten Group Classification System in audit and feedback
Robson Ten Group Classification System group
cohort: All live births occurring at a gestational age ≥24 weeks in a French perinatal network of 10 maternity wards
finding: Implementation of an audit-and-feedback cycle using the Ten Group Classification System did not decrease cesarean section rates or variability between maternity wards.
mod_finding: The study found that implementing an audit-and-feedback cycle using the Ten Group Classification System did not significantly reduce cesarean section rates.
